notes.title: Farewell to Bot Beats 💔
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,

We’re Alexander "Aduxxor" and Jonathan "Machine-Jonte"—two brothers who grew up battling each other in games, building things, and eventually creating Bot Beats together. What started as a rough little 2D coding project turned into a 3D battler we’re proud of, and it’s been incredible seeing people play and enjoy it. 

But reality has caught up with us. Running servers, maintaining updates, and keeping everything alive costs far more than what comes in. Between full-time jobs, family, and the never-ending expenses of keeping an indie game online, we’ve reached a point where it’s no longer sustainable.

With heavy hearts, we have to announce that Bot Beats will be retired, and Brotir AB will be closing down. The game will go offline in the near future—approximately a month from now.

Thank you to everyone who played, supported, or just sent us kind words along the way. Every message, every match, every bit of support meant the world to us. We built this game out of love for robots, games, and a lifetime of sibling rivalry, and sharing that with you has been unforgettable.

—Aduxxor & Machine-Jonte ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Come Hang Out With Us!
notes.notes:
Hello, Bot Beats Community!

We’re excited to finally reach out to you all here on Steam! We’ve been hard at work on Bot Beats, and now we want to hear from you. What do you love about the game? What could we do better? Where would you like to see the game go next? Your feedback is incredibly important to us, and we’d love to start a conversation with you.

We’re also exploring ways to connect with the community more—like hosting events, tournaments, or play-sessions where we can all hang out, compete, and see where we all stack up together. What do you think? Let us know!

If you’d like to chat more, we’d love for you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/nG3d7wu6u4]Discord[/url] community at [url=https://discord.gg/nG3d7wu6u4]Brotir Hangout[/url]. It’s a great place to share ideas, stay updated, and connect with other players. You can also find more information about us and our projects at [url=https://brotir.com/]brotir.com[/url].

For those looking for more detailed information about Bot Beats, you can check out our documentation at [url=https://botbeats.net/documentation]botbeats.net/documentation[/url].

We’re really grateful for your support and excited to see where this journey takes us. Let’s make something amazing together!
